answer: Mechanism: PUF-sealed actuator attestation. Each agent binds to a sealed MEMS die whose unclonable silicon grain answers enclave challenges; a timber acoustic cavity adds a physical actuation signature. Registration uses a nebula-seeded challenge and accepts only when the fused response crosses a summit threshold. Faking many agents requires many distinct dies and cavities; cloning or key extraction is destructive, so Sybil cost scales with hardware fabrication and secure-element attestation.
